Interacting with the blast furnace reveals or unlocks access to an area containing a chest with treasure. milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the purple wall banner on the building's west exterior and face it to confirm visual identification. Target is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5) with max_distance=8 to allow the player to see it from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the 'interact' task requires the player to approach and face the blast furnace (at spawn-relative 5, 0, 5) to right-click it. The player must be within 3 blocks and facing it. This is preferred over use_item since use_item tracking for blast_furnace may not be reliably captured in all MineRL implementations, while proximity+facing confirms the player is in position to interact.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because red stained glass panes drop NOTHING when mined without Silk Touch (CommonSenseAgent confirmed this), so inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we check that at least one glass pane block has been removed from the barrier wall at x=7, z=6-8, y=0-2. The box covers the glass pane wall area. If fewer than 9 glass pane blocks remain (originally 9 placed in a 1x3x3 pattern), at least one was mined.

Uses inventory_has because acquiring treasure means the player takes items from the chest into their inventory. The chest contains 3 diamonds and 5 gold ingots. Checking for at least 1 diamond confirms the player successfully opened the chest and looted it. The player starts with no diamonds, so any diamond in inventory must come from the chest.

scene_description: A stone brick building marked by a purple wall banner on its western exterior. Inside, a blast furnace sits near the entrance. A dividing wall of stone bricks (north section) and red stained glass panes (south section) fully seals the back room. The chest containing diamonds and gold ingots is only accessible by mining through the glass panes. The stone brick segments at z=3-5 and z=9 ensure no bypass routes exist.
task_text: Find the purple banner marking the building entrance. Go inside and interact with the blast furnace. Then mine through the red stained glass panes blocking the back room to reach and loot the treasure chest.
design_notes: Building shell: x=4-10, y=0-4, z=2-10. Interior: x=5-9, y=0-3, z=3-9. Doorway: x=4, y=0-1, z=4-5. Purple banner: x=3, y=2, z=5 (exterior west wall). Blast furnace: x=5, y=0, z=5 (just inside door). Dividing wall at x=7: stone bricks at z=3-5 (north) and z=9 (south edge), red glass panes at z=6-8 (center). Chest: x=9, y=0, z=7 (behind glass barrier). The dividing wall is fully sealed floor-to-ceiling — the ONLY way to reach the chest is to mine through the glass panes.
